task.problem:
TASK-140 RUN-140-012 exposed two deterministic control-plane gaps after TASK-144 was published. The canonical integrated EVIDENCE_ONLY remediation ran from execution base ed83c8cd1c38c4b940f7f12daa49fbef548fafa6, but Codex returned a structural package with result.head_sha=c52a1db8d59270628f69c2cc54c3985553e4abca, exactly the historical remediation.reviewed_sha. Runtime correctly failed closed at COMPLETION_GATE with "RESULT.head_sha mismatch"; failed_head_sha remained ed83c8cd..., changed_files=[], dirty=false, repairable=true, transportable=true, and verification_seconds=null, so the required live agy proof never ran. The Codex REMEDIATION prompt says EVIDENCE_ONLY must not commit and must return a structural ResultPackage, but unlike the native Antigravity prompts it does not explicitly require result.head_sha to bind to actual final Git HEAD / the admitted run base for zero-mutation execution.
A second latent gap prevents a correct repair from recovering the evidence intent. Generic REPAIR completion currently always runs TASK.verification.required. When the failed origin is a REMEDIATION, its exact remediation.affected_verification is not preserved into repair completion. For FINDING-140-006 that would mean a FINALIZE_CANDIDATE repair could become structurally valid yet still never execute the independent live agy 1.2.6 AC8 proof that the EVIDENCE_ONLY remediation was authored to collect. This violates evidence continuity even though TASK-144 correctly preserves the integrated result base and semantic repair lineage.
